summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Vizija Mebel bilingual furniture site. All 10 backend pytest tests pass (health, quotes create/list/validate, contact create/list/validate, catalog PDF). All critical frontend flows verified: MK default with 'МЕБЕЛ ИЗРАБОТЕН' hero, instant MK↔EN language toggle, all 6 nav data-testids route correctly, all 4 legal pages load, configurator core flow (type→style→finish rich_walnut→hardware→preset-medium) with live summary panel showing all 5 fields (Тип/Стил/Завршница/Оков/Димензии) and quote submission → success overlay, Products filters (7 category / 5 material / 5 color) & 10 CNC swatches & download-catalog-btn linking to /api/catalog/pdf, Gallery lightbox with next/prev/close, Contact form submission → contact-success + Google map iframe rendering.
critical_code_review_comments: step-tab testids are 0-indexed (step-tab-0..step-tab-5). Review request implied 1-indexed via 'step-tab-N'; not a bug, just note for future testers.
request-design-btn only rendered on the LAST step of the configurator; summary-request-btn is the always-visible primary CTA. Both work.
server.py: on_event('shutdown') is deprecated in FastAPI — consider lifespan handler (non-blocking, cosmetic).
Backend allows list_quotes / list_contacts publicly (no auth). Acceptable for MVP but note for prod hardening (PII exposure of customer submissions).
seed_data_creation: Tests created TEST_-prefixed quote and contact records in MongoDB (test_database). Refs generated (VM-xxxxxxxx). Safe to leave or purge.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Configurator step tabs are 0-indexed: step-tab-0=type, step-tab-1=style, step-tab-2=finish, step-tab-3=hardware, step-tab-4=dimensions, step-tab-5=notes. Style options only render after a furniture type is selected. Backend tests already implemented in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, 10 tests). Catalog PDF endpoint at GET /api/catalog/pdf returns application/pdf, ~5KB. Configurator quote submits at POST /api/quotes and contact at POST /api/contact — both return 200 with persisted docs. Language stored in localStorage key vm_lang (default 'mk').
